reference_repair.finding: Historical Julia code copies expected res_* assembly files and touches CUDA; it does not compute k-mer counts or sequence assembly. This is an S1 semantic placeholder. Preserve original bytes and implement the actual native hash/CAS/cohort/quality-rating/iterative-walk algorithm. Native lane expression also has a concrete initialization defect; its minimal original GPU probe happened to match, so no observed original numerical failure is claimed. Scoped lane-mask repair and diagnostic output initialization are conditional native interventions.

raw_event.observed_error: KernelException / device InexactError on thread65 during warmup; no timed trial emitted.
raw_event.cause: CUDA.jl6.2.1 shfl_sync uses one-based lane indexing and subtracts1 internally. Passing native lane0 caused conversion of -1 to UInt32 and device abort. Device compilation had succeeded.
raw_event.root_cause_evidence: CUDACore/NlVPI/src/device/intrinsics/warp.jl: mode idx maps src to src-1 before UInt32 NVVM call.
raw_event.resolution: Pass Julia lane1, equivalent to native lane0. Keep actual warp broadcast operation; no unsupported-feature claim.

raw_event.observed_error: Block register count exceeds device limit:160 registers/thread *512 threads/block=81920 >65536 registers/block. No timed trial emitted.
raw_event.cause: Full assembly kernel register allocation exceeded legal resources at the required native512-thread geometry.
raw_event.resolution: Set explicit maxregs=128 for CUDA.jl assembly launch, allowing compiler spills rather than changing native geometry. Record resource policy and possible spill cost.
